name: Dora Flowers
address: Al Mamura Building - 63 Al Rigga Rd - Al Muraqqabat - Deira - Dubai - United Arab Emirates
owner_description: Flower shop for all the special occasions of your life

reviews.author: Belinda Movido
reviews.text: I ordered a wedding bouquet 3 days ago, I even talked to the guy in the store to give me a very nice flowers I want  white fresh flowers for the reason it is for my wedding, and the guy told me that if I want fresh flowers he need time at least to request it so I adjust my timings for picking up to 10am instead of 9am (their time for opening) so my partner picked up the flowers 10am but unfortunately it turns out the flowers are not fresh, so many flaws and near to withered, I never been so disappointed like this. As a person who loves flowers I know its quality and I expected a lot but they really ruined my special day just seeing the flowers they made, and the fact I want to preserve the flowers because it must be special I ended up throwing it due to disappointment. Absolutely I will never trust their shop again. If they cannot make the request they better be honest or they just recommend other shop instead (If I just knew)
reviews.owner_reply:
Thank you for sharing your feedback. We are truly sorry to hear that the bouquet did not meet your expectations, especially for such an important occasion.

We would like to clarify that all our flowers are prepared fresh on the day of collection, and your order was handled with care. However, we understand that what you received did not reflect this, and we sincerely apologize for the disappointment this caused.

Your experience is not what we want for any of our customers, especially for a wedding. We are taking this matter seriously and reviewing it with our team to ensure better consistency and quality.

reviews.owner_reply: We’re grateful for your kind words and support. Your feedback motivates us to continue giving the best service possible.

Price is not worth it especially it’s special occasion 😔
reviews.owner_reply:
We’re truly sorry to hear that you were disappointed with your wedding bouquet. We would like to clarify that the bouquet was made using fresh, newly prepared flowers, not the displayed flowers.

We always do our best to prepare fresh flowers for every order, especially for special occasions. We’re sorry that the bouquet did not meet your expectations, and we would have been happy to address any concerns immediately if we had been informed upon pick up

We genuinely value your feedback and will take it into consideration to improve our service.

reviews.author: Noel Vinoya
reviews.text:
It was my first time buying from Dora Flowers. I didn’t have any recommendations or suggestions online, I just happened to see the store while strolling around the area. I reached out to them on WhatsApp using the contact details on their Instagram page (@doraflowersdubai), and their customer service was very helpful. The staff I spoke with was accommodating and thoroughly explained everything I needed, including my preferred arrangements and flower types.

They conveniently reserved my order, and when I picked it up at the store, the staff even added extra roses, which made the experience even better. Their flowers are affordable, and the arrangements are beautiful. Strongly recommended!
